raw:
Stone lets the unanswered prompt rest. After his promised five minutes, he gathers his lens and notes.

“Take the volume upstairs when you finish. Return it Thursday.”

The chapter gives the old human seat a plainer shape than the Academy survey does. Its work is not agreement for its own sake, but keeping each party from calling an unclear term consent after the fact. The examples are procedural and specific: versions of a treaty kept side by side; objections entered before a vote; a representative required to name who has authority to bind a community.

By the final pages, the card game beyond the wall has gone quiet. A chair scrapes in the common room; someone wishes Dena goodnight. Rain-light flickers blue across the library ceiling.

When you close the brown volume, Professor Stone is still at his table, bent over his brittle papers beneath the lamp.
